# Environmental,


Social & Governance


## ESG at


Flowserve


Our Approach


Flowserve strives to enable a clean energy future by advancing technologies that reduce climate impact, embed sustainability within our core operations, and strengthen our purpose-driven culture. Propelled by this vision, we have aligned our ESG policy around 3 pillars: Climate, Culture, and Core Responsibility.


[Read our ESG statement](https://flowserve.widen.net/view/pdf/8gzet8rmba/COPOL003030_EN.docx?t.download=true&u=djdxdd)


## 2025 Flowserve


Impact Report


The Impact report highlights how Flowserve creates value through responsible growth, environmental stewardship, support for people and communities, strong governance, and the real-world impact of our products, services, and operations.


[Read the 2025 report](https://www.flowserve.com/esg/impact-report/)


## Flowserve


ESG Pillars


## Climate


Our Climate pillar demonstrates our commitment to paving the way for a clean energy future - both in our operations and for our customers.


## Culture


Our Culture pillar recognizes our dedication to nurture each other’s potential and foster a safe, collaborative environment that supports both our employees and our local communities.


## Core Responsibility


Our Core Responsibility pillar focuses on governance, emphasizing ethical business practices and adherence to global laws and regulations.


## Industry


Recognition


Whether it’s providing critical products and services that make the planet a cleaner, safer place or strengthening the fabric of the communities in which we live and work, we are proud to be recognized as a leader in making the world better for everyone.


## Flowserve Ranked


as One of America’s Most Responsible Companies


Our focus on building a strong culture, giving back to the communities where we live and work, continuously improving our operations and enabling our customers to reach their own sustainability goals.


## Flowserve Named to TIME


Magazine's List of World's Best Companies


The ranking measures employee satisfaction, revenue growth, and sustainability transparency.


## Flowserve Named One


of America’s Greenest Companies


This recognition, based on environmental sustainability data and disclosures as well as corporate social responsibility commitments and progress, highlights our commitment to partner with our customers as they accomplish their own operational and sustainability goals.


## Flowserve Named One of


The Best-Managed Companies


The ranking evaluates major U.S. companies based on five key dimensions: customer satisfaction, employee engagement and development, innovation, social responsibility, and financial strength.


## Contact Our


ESG Team


We invite our partners and customers to reach out with questions on ESG topics.


[Get in touch](https://www.flowserve.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#7c190f1b3c1a10130b0f190e0a19521f1311)
